description:
Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 4 (demolition and construction management plan) and 9 (Tree Survey, Arboricultural Impact Assessment, Arboricultural Method Statement and Tree Protection
Plan) of planning permission ref. 18377/APP/2026/131, dated 28-05-26 (Change of use from use Class E (Commercial) to use Class C3 (Residential), erection of a single storey rear infill extension and rear dormer, removal of rear external staircase and replacement with balcony, and roof alterations with an increase in ridge height, loft conversion to habitable use for 4 x self-contained residential units, rear dormer, roof lights to front together with associated refuse storage, cycle parking, landscaping and ancillary works.)
